ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Process Patterns NTDS.DIT Exfil
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process patterns used in NTDS.DIT exfiltration

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\NTDSDump\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\NTDSDumpEx\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ntds\\\.dit.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*system\\\.hiv.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*NTDSgrab\\\.ps1.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ac\\ i\\ ntds.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create\\ full.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c\\ copy\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\windows\\\\ntds\\\\ntds\\\.dit.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*activate\\ instance\\ ntds.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create\\ full.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ntds\\\.dit.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ntds\\\.dit.*") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\apache.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\tomcat.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\apache.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\tomcat.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*"))))
